title: When Reconstruction Is Not Enough: Doubly Robust Counterfactual and Interventional Mediation Analysis with Learned Multimodal Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.30220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learned representations of high-dimensional multimodal health records are increasingly used to adjust for confounding, yet they are usually trained to reconstruct the data rather than preserve the information that causal identification requires. We study counterfactual outcomes under alternative treatments, including phenotype-specific effects and patient-level counterfactual risk profiles of the kind digital twins provide, and interventional direct and indirect effects under exposure-induced intermediate confounding. We give conditions under which a representation preserves identification and show that interventional mediation is more demanding than counterfactual comparison. translated_title: 当重建还不够：基于学习多模态表示的双稳健反事实与干预中介分析
translated_abstract: 高维多模态健康记录的学习表示越来越多地被用于调整混杂因素，但它们通常被训练用于重建数据，而非保留因果识别所需的信息。我们研究了替代治疗下的反事实结果，包括表型特异性效应和数字孪生所提供的那种患者层面反事实风险概况，以及暴露诱导的中间混杂下的干预直接与间接效应。我们给出了表示保持可识别性的条件，并表明干预中介分析比反事实比较要求更高。我们证明了没有任何仅基于协变量的训练目标——无论是重建、对比学习还是物理信息驱动——能够证明一个表示是充分的；并且在线性结构模型中，一个表示可能仅损失任意小的重建准确度……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了仅基于协变量的训练目标（重建、对比或物理信息）无法保证多模态表示足以支持因果识别，给出了表示保持可识别性的条件，并提出了双稳健的反事实与干预中介分析方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that no covariate-only training objective—reconstruction, contrastive, or physics-informed—can certify a representation's sufficiency for causal identification, characterizes when learned multimodal representations preserve identification, and develops doubly robust counterfactual and interventional mediation analysis.
